assumptions.geometry: Observed finite unwrapped coordinates; distances are descriptive, not a scoring function or bond-order threshold.
assumptions.charge: Fragment charges -1, 0, +1 are screening assumptions, not measured charges. Whole-box neutrality does not fix fragment charge.
assumptions.radicals: The neutral radical configuration uses the toolkit radical option. Spin/multiplicity is not assigned.
assumptions.representation: Fixed explicit atoms/H and adjacency; no added H or edge changes. Integer Kekule orders for display; resonance alternatives are not exhaustively enumerated.
assumptions.interpretation: A returned candidate is compatible within this bounded search, not an accepted electronic state or a unique assignment. Failures do not establish chemical impossibility. No naming or stereochemical assignment.

selection: All 23 existing deterministic atlas review examples, selected before bond-order outcomes; no additions or exclusions. Not a representative success-rate sample.
